summary: Eni S.p.A., the Italian energy major, filed a Form 6-K disclosing daily open-market purchases of its own ordinary shares executed on Euronext Milan, the standard foreign-private-issuer equivalent of a US issuer's Form 8-K buyback report. Under the second tranche of the program approved at the May 6, 2026 shareholders' meeting, Eni bought 3,184,396 shares from August 31 to September 4, 2026, equal to 0.11% of share capital, at a 23.5523 euro weighted average, totaling 74,999,944.45 euro. Cumulative holdings reached 5.05%.
